notes.title: Threesome mode just got a massive update!
notes.content:
Hi there futa enthusiasts!
As an addition to our last big update we're rebuilding the threesome mode to offer a way better experience!
Now all characters will be actively involved in the positions!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711292/b49e9d05241e9dc32ad4a8c2a34dbdcf49734eb2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711292/aac5066b9d3d840f847e3b464a73808321b57551.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711292/1eec1ae63567e16e422a325d8a12736222ff68a4.gif[/img]
Altogether, we believe it's a much better game now but as always... we are committed to keep pushing updates and constantly improving the game.
Please let know if you are running into issues, we love to hear your feedback.

notes.title: 🎉 Announcement: Costume Fighter is Live – Get Ready for the ultimate showdown!
notes.content:
Get ready to brawl in this side-splitting showdown where fighters don't just bring their fists to the fight, but their wackiest costumes and zaniest moves.

'Costume Fighter' is not your typical fighting game – it's the hottest extravaganza that will keep you entertained and in stitches for hours on end. Get ready to embrace the chaos, battle in style, and become the champion of getting laid. Are you ready to dress for success and fight for orgasms?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711292/22b799e903f50700b38d1e6ede1470594899fae0.jpg[/img]

[b]
Complex movesets[/b]
Explore more than 12 different poses in all the scenes.

[b]1v1 is only the beginning[/b]
Threesome mode is availible in all our scenes. We all now 1v1 works, but get the "fight" to another level adding one more character to the action.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711292/5e6d7436076550db33265e47c373884170f48575.gif[/img]
[b]Fully Voice Acted Action[/b]
We let our VAs know what they were getting into ahead of time so thankfully nobody passed out when they received their scripts. The result of their hard work should get you even harder!

[b]FINISH HER![/b]
Inlcuding 4 different moneyshot finisher moves to end with style!
